input: do we have a web ui for tracking which projects are on the roadmap and what progress is being made should be part of the site.

deviations.why: Direct user request (roadmap progress UI on the site), not a routed run; recorded under polish.
deviations.result: queue.test.mjs 14/14, updates.test.mjs 20/20, real-repo render checked at 1100px and 390px

notes: Answer: queue/ (roadmap) and updates/ (progress) already existed; added per-project progress (14-day merge strip, count, last change, latest merges) and a Roadmap at a glance table to queue/. Merges are shared from buildUpdates to avoid a second git log. Phone width: the shared site header already overflows to 413px at 390px (pre-existing, not from this change); the new table hides its strip column under 560px.
